meta.name: ponytail-debt
meta.description: Harvest every `ponytail:` comment in the codebase into a debt ledger, so the deliberate shortcuts and deferrals ponytail leaves behind get tracked instead of rotting into "later means never". Use when the user says "ponytail debt", "/ponytail-debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", "ponytail ledger", or "what did we mark to do later". One-shot report, changes nothing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用特殊注释标记了技术债务却无人跟进
copy.tagline_en: Generate a debt ledger from code annotations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you mark technical debt with special comments but no one follows up

howto.what: 扫描代码库中所有 `ponytail:` 注释,汇总成债务账本:每处一行,列出简化内容、上限和升级触发条件,并标记无触发器的风险项。只读报告,不修改任何文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“ponytail debt”“/ponytail-debt”“list the shortcuts”等触发词时触发。一次性报告。

say.note: 列出所有 ponytail 注释。

say.text: what did we mark to do later

howto.what_en: Scans the codebase for all `ponytail:` comments and compiles them into a debt ledger: one row per instance, showing what was simplified, the ceiling, and the upgrade trigger, flagging entries with no trigger as risk. Read-only report, changes nothing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ponytail debt", "/ponytail-debt", "list the shortcuts", etc. One-shot report.
